jsch generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Color

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "string",
  "enum": ["red", "green", "blue"]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/colorpkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestColor_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	for _, want := range []string{"red", "green", "blue"} {
		var c Color
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"`+want+`"`), &c); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("Unmarshal(%q): %v", want, err)
			continue
		}
		if string(c) != want {
			t.Errorf("got %q, want %q", string(c), want)
		}
	}
}

func TestColor_NotInEnum(t *testing.T) {
	var c Color
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"yellow"`), &c)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want enum rejection")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not in enum") {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want enum-rejection message", err)
	}
}
